description: This code writes three samples, defines weighted criteria, and calculates hand-score totals.

steps.description: SAMPLES holds three arguments about library hours. The loop writes each text into the samples folder.
RUBRIC defines three criteria, their weights, and four visible levels for each. The assertion checks that the weights total 100.
weighted_total multiplies each criterion weight by its awarded level divided by four.

steps.answer: s01.txt does, because it has level 4 for every criterion.
steps.question: Which sample gets the full weighted total from these hand levels?

steps.description: HAND supplies one level per criterion for each sample. The loop prints the weighted total for each set of levels.
The printed hand totals are 100.0 for s01.txt, 57.5 for s02.txt, and 25.0 for s03.txt.

title: Score samples with a rubric
